sn51.13:1.3: So anuppannānam pāpakānam akusalānaṃ dhammānam anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || ||
sn51.13:1.4: Uppannānaṃ pāpakānam akusalānam dhammānam pahānāya chandam janeti vāyamati viriyam āravhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati ||
sn51.13:1.5: Anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānam uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || ||
sn51.13:1.6: Uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || ||
sn51.13:1.8: Iti ayaṃ ca chando ayaṃ ca chandasamādhi ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā ||
sn51.13:2.1: Viriyaṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhim labhati cittassa ekaggatam ||
sn51.13:2.4: Uppannānaṃ kusalānam dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || ||
sn51.13:2.6: Iti idaṃ ca viriyam ayañca viriyasamādhi ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā ||
sn51.13:3.1: Cittaṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ labhati cittassa ekaggatam ||

sn51.13:3.6: Iti idaṃ ca cittaṃ ayaṃ ca cittasamādhi ime ca padhānasaṅkharā ||
